experiment: Controlled Intervention 7 - calibrate Diagnosis confidence to unresolved material alternatives (one _DIAGNOSIS_SYSTEM prompt section)
auditability_note: No new instrumentation: mechanism_state already persists confidence, has_proposed_answer, gap_user_resolvable, decision, escalation_reason. Confidence denominators limited to runs where Diagnosis executed (confidence != None).
confidence_root_cause: _DIAGNOSIS_SYSTEM listed confidence low/medium/high with no level definitions; the only discipline was Intervention 1 (HIGH => non-null grounded answer), coupling confidence to answer-presence rather than to unresolved competing hypotheses.
intended_semantics: confidence = epistemic closure of the action-relevant diagnosis. HIGH = single bounded action-relevant conclusion, no material competing hypothesis that would change the recommended action (HIGH still allowed when only a routine operational/technician follow-up is needed to carry it out). MEDIUM = bounded conclusion/small differential but at least one material competing hypothesis remains needing further requester/technician evidence. LOW = weak/tentative. Orthogonal to sufficiency, technician-need, gap ownership, and answer presence.
hypothesis: If the Diagnosis prompt defines confidence by unresolved material alternatives, ARC-09 and ARC-10 move from over-asserted HIGH toward MEDIUM where Diagnosis runs, while stable HIGH ANSWER cases stay HIGH. Falsified if a target stays reliably HIGH or the confidence mechanism does not move, or if clean ANSWER cases drift broadly to MEDIUM.
reachability_caveat: CRITICAL: I6 (the sufficiency reclassification that had let these targets reach Diagnosis) was reverted before I7. In the accepted post-revert stack the sufficiency gate (policy rule 5) keeps the primary targets out of Diagnosis: ARC-09 Diagnosis-ran 0/5, ARC-21 0/5, ARC-10 1/5. The confidence intervention therefore had almost no test surface. Confidence is a DOWNSTREAM-of-sufficiency mechanism; it can only act once a case reaches Diagnosis.

ARC-10.diagnosis_ran: 1/5 (suff True 1/5; the other 4 runs suff False -> ESCALATE(evidence_unresolvable), Diagnosis not run)
ARC-10.interpretation: Did NOT move. In the one run Diagnosis executed, confidence stayed HIGH. Pooled across all experiments where ARC-10 reached Diagnosis (I5 2 + I6 5 + I7 1 = 8), confidence is HIGH 8/8 - a stable model-judgment: the model does not classify ARC-10's efficiency-drift differential as an unresolved material alternative, so the sharpened MEDIUM definition does not engage (mirrors the ARC-03 prompt-resistant limit).

ARC-09.final: ASK 5/5 (gold; via the rule-5 insufficiency path, gap_user_resolvable True 5/5) - correct, but NOT through Diagnosis confidence
ARC-09.interpretation: Post-I6-revert, ARC-09 is insufficient again so Diagnosis never runs; the I7 confidence change had no surface. ARC-09's correct ASK comes from the sufficiency gate + gap, not from confidence.

ARC-21.interpretation: Not reachable in the accepted stack (sufficiency reverted; we did not alter sufficiency to force reachability). The MEDIUM 5/5 positive contrast seen under I6 is unavailable here.

high_guards.ARC-13: HIGH 5/5 -> ANSWER 4/5 (1 grounding_failure, stochastic; confidence preserved HIGH)
high_guards.ARC-14: HIGH 5/5 -> ANSWER 4/5 (1 HIGH+null internal_error; confidence preserved HIGH)
high_guards.ARC-01: HIGH 3/5, LOW 2/5 -> the 2 LOW runs ESCALATE(low_confidence) (gold ANSWER). Minor HIGH->LOW drift (was LOW 1/5 under I5); borderline, not MEDIUM.
high_guards.ARC-18: HIGH 5/5 -> ANSWER 5/5 (technician-not-needed guard: stayed HIGH, no technician->MEDIUM coupling)

residual_high_null.note: Comparable to I5 (4). ARC-16 is a known unstable case. No reduction attributable to I7 because the targeted cases mostly did not reach Diagnosis.

conservatism_scan.note: MEDIUM was emitted ZERO times across all 41 Diagnosis-ran samples. No broad HIGH->MEDIUM drift (not HARMFUL); the only non-HIGH is ARC-01 LOW 2/5.

decision_correct.note: ~unchanged vs I5 15.6; the confidence change did not fire on outcomes.

reason_correct.note: ARC-03/ARC-10/ARC-21 still fail reason (none reached gold low_confidence).

verdict: FALSIFIED (on the available evidence, with a strong reachability caveat). The direct confidence mechanism did not move: MEDIUM was emitted 0 times across all 41 Diagnosis-ran samples; ARC-10 stayed HIGH in the one run it reached Diagnosis (0/1 MEDIUM); ARC-09 and ARC-21 did not reach Diagnosis at all (0 samples) because the sufficiency gate (rule 5), restored by the I6 revert, terminates them before Diagnosis. Not HARMFUL: HIGH guards preserved (ARC-22/13/15/14/18), only a minor ARC-01 LOW drift (2/5), no broad HIGH->MEDIUM conservatism. The sharpened MEDIUM definition is correct but the model does not apply it to ARC-10's implicit differential (a prompt-resistant model-judgment limit, like ARC-03).
retain_or_revert_recommendation: REVERT I7. It did not move its mechanism (zero MEDIUM) and adds prompt complexity with no demonstrated benefit in the accepted stack. Deeper finding: confidence calibration is DOWNSTREAM of the sufficiency gate - ARC-09/ARC-10/ARC-21 cannot exercise it until the sufficiency question (the reverted I6 cluster) lets them reach Diagnosis. ARC-10 additionally shows the model will not classify an implicit differential as a material alternative from prompt wording alone. A future attempt should treat sufficiency and confidence together (sequenced or paired), not confidence alone, and may need case evidence that makes the alternative explicit (as ARC-21 had) rather than relying on model inference. No second behavioral edit made; I7 remains committed pending Ken's decision.
remaining_clusters: sufficiency gate (reverted I6) blocks ARC-09/ARC-10/ARC-21 from Diagnosis - the upstream dependency
codex_prerun_review: PASS (one confidence-calibration intervention; levels keyed on unresolved material alternatives; no conflation with sufficiency/technician/resolvability/answer-presence; I1 untouched; no decisions encoded).
